title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
EE Merthyr Tydfil Contact Centre - Full-time role - 37.5 Hours per week

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Merthyr is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Merthyr contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Thrive Oldham are recruiting on behalf of our well established client a Customer Service Administrator in the Merthyr Area.

Job Title: Customer Service Administrator

Reporting to: Internal Sales Manager

Overview

This is an exciting opportunity for a successful candidate to join a well-established company.

This role is fully Customer Service focused, and you will be heavily involved in order processing high volumes daily and updating customers throughout the whole process from initial ordering to delivery.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities:
- Providing excellent customer service to clients of all levels
- Processing sales orders on the inhouse system accurately and efficiently
- Updating clients on the process of their orders on the telephone and email
- Updating clients on delivery dates and amendments
- Booking export transport on customer portals.
- Liaising with internal departments on daily orders and delivery schedules
- Serve as a point of contact for customers and liaise between clients and the sales team
- Address customer questions regarding our products and services
- Maintaining excellent relationships with our customer
- Maintain accurate customer account details
- Provide effective communication with customers, clients, colleagues and 3rd parties to ensure successful outcomes with a 'Right First Time' mentality
- General administrative duties to support the team

Key Skills:
- Experience of working in a customer service order processing role within manufacturing is essential for this role
- Excellent organizational and time management skills
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy
- Must have the ability to work efficiently under pressure, prioritizing workload to meet deadlines
- Excellent IT skills are essential to undertake this role, in particular, Outlook and Excel

8am-5pm Mon-Thur and 8am-12 midday Fridays

Salary Competitive

What you need to do next:

If you are interested in being considered for this position, please apply with your updated CV

Thrive are acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

If you have not heard from a consultant within 7 days, please assume you have been unsuccessful on this occasion.

INDOLD

title: Service Administrator
description:
Service Administrator

Location: Caerphilly
Salary: 28k
Job Type: Hybrid

The Role

We are looking for an organised and customer-focused Service Administrator to join a busy service team in Wales.

This is a varied role supporting customers, engineers and service management to ensure service contracts are delivered efficiently and to a high standard. You'll be working in a fast-paced environment where organisation, communication and attention to detail are key.

This is what you'll be doing

As Service Administrator, you'll provide essential administrative and coordination support across the service operation.
- Coordinate and maintain the contract diary, helping to ensure service and maintenance activities are scheduled and managed effectively.
- Act as a key point of contact for customer enquiries, dealing with queries where possible and escalating more complex issues to the appropriate team member.
- Support engineers with job scheduling, job information, parts and materials, ensuring they have the information and resources required to complete their work.
- Maintain accurate service records and documentation, including engineer paperwork, asset information, KPI records and SharePoint files.
- Support parts and materials ordering, customer feedback, records, as well as other administration required to support the smooth running of the service team.

This is what you'll bring to the team

We're looking for a Service Administrator who is organised, reliable and confident dealing with a variety of customers and colleagues. You'll be comfortable managing competing priorities and working in a busy environment.
- Previous experience in an administrative, customer service or coordination role.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate records.
- Confident communication skills, both over the telephone and by email, with a professional and customer-focused approach.
- Good IT skills, including experience with Microsoft Word and Excel. Knowledge of SharePoint or CRM systems would be advantageous.
- The ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and work positively as part of a wider team.

This is what you'll get in return

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your administration and service coordination experience within a busy and supportive team.

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with customers, engineers and service management while gaining valuable experience across contract administration, customer service and service operations.
- Competitive salary, depending on experience
- Great culture
- Varied and interesting responsibilities
- Supportive working environment
- Opportunity to develop your skills and experience
- Opportunity to play an important role within the service team
- Hybrid working

Apply now for more information and to be considered for the Service Administrator position.

title: Accounts and Payroll Assistant
company: Môrwell Talent Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts & Payroll Assistant

Location: Pontyclun Fully Office-Based
Salary: £32,000 £34,000 per annum plus bonus

About the Company

Our client is a highly successful and innovative business with a turnover of approximately £25 million and ambitious plans for continued growth. They have built a strong reputation for investing in their people, embracing technology and continually improving processes across the organisation.

As the business continues to expand, they are looking to recruit an experienced and detail-focused Accounts & Payroll Assistant to join their finance team. This is a varied, hands-on position offering exposure to a broad range of finance activities, including accounts payable, expenses management, reconciliations, payment processing and payroll. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the smooth running of the finance function, maintaining accurate financial records and helping to drive process improvements.

The Role

Working as part of a collaborative finance team, you will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, with responsibility for accounts payable, employee expenses, payroll administration and general accounting support.

The role offers an excellent opportunity for someone with a solid background in accounts and payroll who enjoys variety, takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records and is confident managing deadlines across multiple areas of responsibility.

Payroll will form an important part of the position, alongside wider accounts duties, so the ideal candidate will be comfortable working across different aspects of finance and providing support wherever required.

Key Responsibilities will include -

Accounts & Finance
- Support the day-to-day running of the finance function, ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.
- Process supplier invoices, allocate costs correctly and ensure appropriate approvals are obtained.
- Reconcile supplier accounts and statements, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Support bi-monthly payment runs and process ad hoc payments as required.
- Manage supplier queries and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external contacts.
- Carry out bank reconciliations and assist with cash management activities.
- Provide support with month-end procedures and general ledger-related tasks.
- Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation and appropriate audit trails.
- Assist with general finance administration and provide cover across the wider finance team.

Payroll & Employee Administration
- Process monthly payroll for approximately 80 UK employees, ensuring salaries are accurate and paid on time.
- Maintain payroll records, pension contributions, employee benefits, deductions and statutory payments.
- Ensure payroll information is accurate and processed in accordance with relevant legislation.
- Act as a point of contact for payroll queries, liaising with employees and managers to resolve issues.
- Support the administration of employee benefits, including pensions and employee vehicle schemes.
- Maintain accurate employee records within Sage HR and Go 2 Clock.
- Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding administration.

Expenses Management
- Administer the employee expenses process using SAP Concur.
- Review and process expense claims, checking receipts, coding, VAT treatment and compliance with company policies.
- Resolve queries from employees and approvers to ensure claims are processed promptly.
- Monitor approvals and ensure timely reimbursement of expenses.
- Support expense reporting and reconciliation into SAP Business One.

Wider Business & Operational Support
- Assist with vehicle lease administration, insurance management and driving licence checks.
- Support carbon reporting and the collection of sustainability data.
- Contribute to the development and improvement of finance processes, systems and reporting.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, streamline workflows and support automation initiatives.
- Provide ad hoc assistance with finance projects and other operational activities as required.

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience in a varied accounts and finance role, ideally incorporating payroll responsibilities.
- Practical payroll experience, with the ability to process monthly payroll accurately and independently.
- A good understanding of accounts payable, supplier reconciliations, payment processing and general finance administration.
- Knowledge of payroll legislation, pensions, employee benefits and statutory deductions.
- Experience using Sage Payroll or a similar payroll system.
- Strong IT skills and the ability to work confidently with financial systems and spreadsheets.
- Experience with SAP Business One, SAP Concur or similar systems would be advantageous.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to financial administration.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills and confidence dealing with colleagues, suppliers and employees.
- A proactive, practical approach, with an interest in improving processes and supporting the wider finance team.

We are particularly interested in candidates who enjoy a varied finance position and are happy to work across accounts, payroll and general finance duties within a busy commercial environment.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,000 £34,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- Annual bonus opportunity of up to £4,000.
- 25 days' annual leave plus Bank Holidays.
- NEST pension scheme.
- Free on-site parking.
- 40-hour working week, Monday to Friday, 8:00am 4:30pm, with some flexibility.
- Fully office-based role in Pontyclun.
- Opportunity to join an established, growing business.
- A varied position offering exposure to multiple areas of finance and business operations.
- A supportive and collaborative team environment.
- The opportunity to contribute ideas and make a genuine impact on finance processes and systems.

If you are an experienced accounts and payroll professional looking for a varied role within a growing, forward-thinking business, we would love to hear from you.
